files.name: partition_result.json

item_fields.name: zone_id
item_fields.note: Must be unique across zones; must appear identically in routes_result.json

item_fields.name: retailer_ids
item_fields.note: Retailer idx values (from demo_data.xlsx) assigned to this zone; must be non-empty; union across all zones must equal the positive-demand retailer set exactly (no duplicates, no omissions)

item_fields.name: vehicle_count
item_fields.note: Vehicle count for this zone; read by compute_step1_metrics (line 479) but not hard-validated — absence does not block scoring
item_fields.role_rationale: 479 行仅被塞进 zone_details 回显，compose_quality_score 从未读它

structural_checks: top-level key 'zones' must exist and be a list (hard fail if missing)
zone_id must be unique across all zone entries
retailer_ids must be non-empty for every zone
len(retailer_ids) must not exceed ceil(total_positive_demand_retailers / 5 * 1.2) per zone
union of all retailer_ids must equal the set of positive-demand idx values exactly
no retailer_id may appear in more than one zone

files.name: routes_result.json

root_keys.name: zones
root_keys.note: Exactly 5 entries, one per zone; zone_id set must match partition_result.json exactly

item_fields.name: zone_id
item_fields.note: Must match a zone_id from partition_result.json

item_fields.name: route_id
item_fields.note: Must be unique within the zone; used as a sort key in compute_step2_metrics

item_fields.name: sequence
item_fields.note: Ordered list of retailer idx values visited by this route; all must be positive-demand retailers belonging to this zone's partition; union across all routes in all zones must cover every positive-demand retailer exactly once

item_fields.name: trips
item_fields.note: List of trip objects; used to derive scheduled_trip_count when that field is absent

item_fields.name: trip_id
item_fields.note: Appears only in violation error messages; not used in any computation

item_fields.name: num_stops
item_fields.note: Overload check fires only when num_stops > 0

item_fields.name: scheduled_trip_count
item_fields.note: If absent, defaults to len(trips); must be equal across all 5 routes within a zone

structural_checks: top-level key 'zones' must exist and be a list (hard fail if missing)
zone_id set must match the zone_id set from partition_result.json exactly
each zone must have exactly 5 routes
route_id must be unique within each zone
every retailer idx in every sequence must be a positive-demand retailer belonging to that zone's partition
union of all sequences across all zones must equal the positive-demand retailer set exactly (no duplicates, no omissions)
scheduled_trip_count (or len(trips) when absent) must be equal across all 5 routes within a zone
for each trip where num_stops > 0: load must not exceed 8000.0

aliases_note: No field in either file has an alias. Every key the evaluator reads is hardcoded with a single name and no 'or' fallback chain.
